full_suite.environment: Python 3.12 in Docker; source mounted read-only; isolated caches; AI keys not passed

coverage: Expired source may stage an unselected proposal only if its new deadline and all existing capacity checks permit execution
Original started_at, historical accounting anchor, failed attempts, invocations and source bytes remain unchanged
Wall allowance increases by exactly the positive integral-second deadline delta
Native run_phase_dev restores the preserved implementation under the extended bound and revalidates owners
Missing separate deadline authorization and expired proposed deadlines are refused
Ordinary verification-repair consent cannot authorize a wall-time change or other profile extensions
Changed live deadline and malformed extension chain fail integrity checks
Real stopped-source CLI preview matches the prepared review subject and dispatches zero providers

limitations: This capability is paired with the existing reviewed captured-timeout fixture repair; it is not a general deadline-only migration
It does not renew separate expired feedback-recording authority or increase its automatic quotas
Offline validation and preview do not activate the historical run or establish its readiness
